has_ambient_sound_instance() is false, unit_ambient_sound_source() and start_ambient_sound() return zero, and no SoundInstance/sample options are retained. The call site is unreachable with this host's actual ambient state.

The bound circles are GuiLayoutWidget projections. They do not carry a GuiSectionRuntimeImplementation, its canonical GuiWidgetOwner, section fields or emission services. A synthetic Section owner would not be the host widget's real state.

Root +CCh interface id and +E4h restore payload are not retained: hud_root_screen_set_interface only records the setter. controlled_unit_flag_379() also reads a substituted false. Defaults would bypass the native toggle decisions rather than consume the missing real state.

A large adapter supplying defaults would not satisfy the reconstructed body's contract; lists and scalar unit fields alone are insufficient.

The HUD retains only summary.audio_environment, not the sound manager's SoundConfigurationState/listener table or SoundLevelNameHost. Using an invented listener table would merely round-trip the same environment string; the real application's sound state is outside this host's available interface.
